title: Markets Buckle As Geopolitical Tensions Lift Oil Prices to an October High: Oct. 12, 2026
summary: Markets are buckling to start a busy week as geopolitical tensions lifted oil prices to an October high, raising inflation worries while quelling hopes of substantially lighter interest rates in the near term.
